Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game! The action now shifts back to Sharjah for the next encounter where England will face Sri Lanka on 1st November 2021. That match will begin at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT). Do not forget to join us for that game. Till then, cheers and goodbye!

Kane Williamson, the skipper of New Zealand, says that there is always planning while going into the game and the players put up an incredible fight today. Says that they build pressure throughout and the bowlers did the job for them. Says the spinners were outstanding today. Tells that India are strong but they try and focus on their cricket. Mentions that Sodhi has been a brilliant T20 bowler and his experience playing across the world helps them.

Virat Kohli, the skipper of India, says that it feels quite bizarre and they were not brave enough both with the bat and ball which hurted them in the end. Tells that New Zealand came out with intent with the ball and their batters did not manage to start well. Adds that you have to be optimistic in this format and back yourselves, take pride in playing well for your country. Signs off by saying that there is still lots to play for and they will look to put on a good show.

Ish Sodhi is the Player of the Match. He says that this is the first time they have set their foot in Dubai. Tells that the wicket was different than the one in Sharjah. Adds that the big part of the game is to use spinners well in the middle. Further says that Southee getting that late wicket in the Powerplay helped them. Informs that they had a tough loss against Pakistan. Ends by saying that they wanted to do their best in this game.
....Presentation Time...

Earlier in the day, New Zealand restricted India to their lowest first-innings total ever in the T20 World Cup, courtesy of some exceptional bowling performance from their bowlers. The Kiwis had only 111 runs to chase and they did that with 33 balls to spare. India now have their task cut out as they have to win their remaining three games comprehensively and also hope that few of the results go their way in order to stay in the race for semi-final.

Nothing much to say about the Indian bowlers as they had only 111 runs to play with and they did not manage to put any sort of pressure on the Kiwi batters, apart from Jasprit Bumrah who bent his back and managed to pick up a couple of wickets. New Zealand's openers came out with intent and the other bowlers had no answers to it.

Well, New Zealand had only 111 runs to chase and they did that with utmost ease. Their openers, Martin Guptill and Daryl Mitchell started well but just as the former was looking to tee off he perished. Daryl Mitchell though carried on his merry way and he found boundaries at will in the middle. He fell short of his fifty by only a run but the damage had already been done. Kane Williamson, coming in at number 3,  just knocked it 'round the corner and ensured that there aren't anymore hiccups. All in all, they made a mockery of India's total and got those crucial two points.

This has been a comprehensive win for New Zealand and they keep their winning streak against India at the ICC events intact. They have been quite clinical with both bat and ball in such a crucial game and things are going from bad to worse for India in this tournament as they lose two in a row now.
Fuller in length, on the pads. Kane Williamson flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 8 WICKETS!
Short of a length, on middle and leg. Devon Conway pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single. Scores level now!
On a length, outside off. Kane Williamson guides it to third man for one.
Shardul Thakur is back on.
Full and on off, whipped down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Lovely batting! Fuller in length, on off. Kane Williamson shimmies down the track and lofts it towards long off for a boundary. New Zealand are one hit away from winning the match now.
WIDE! Short once again, on middle. Too short this time as Kane Williamson sways away from it. Wide called for height.
FOUR! Well played! Short ball, on middle. Kane Williamson waits for it and plays a ramp shot. The ball goes over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Short ball, on middle. Conway pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Touch fuller, on off. Kane Williamson works it to long on for one.
Outside off, Kane Williamson dabs it to backward point.
On a length, outside off. Devon Conway punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Length ball, on leg. Devon Conway looks to glance it on the leg side but misses. He gets hit on the pads.
Devon Conway is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Fuller in length, on middle. Daryl Mitchell takes the aerial route and heaves it to long on. Didn't get the distance he wanted and KL Rahul takes an easy catch. Misses out on a well-deserved maiden T20I fifty. Daryl Mitchell departs for a well made 49 though.
Commentary.Howout: c KL Rahul b Jasprit Bumrah

Commentary.Commentary: Slower anf fuller, outside off. Daryl Mitchell nudges it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Short and angling down the leg side. Daryl Mitchell watches the ball go over him. Wide called.
On a good length, on off. Kane Williamson dabs it down to third man for a run.
A yorker, on middle. Kane Williamson jams it out to mid on.
Short ball, angling down. Kane Williamson gets low and pulls it to deep square leg for one more. 17 needed in 48 balls.
Short in length, on middle. Daryl Mitchell whips it to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Kane Williamson skips down and eases it down to long on for a single.
A length ball, on middle, a slower ball. Daryl Mitchell pulls it to deep backward square leg for one.
A length ball, on the pads, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Kane Williamson pushes off the outer half to point.
Hardik Pandya is introduced into the attack now.
On a length, outside off. Kane dabs it to third man for a single.
WIDE! Bangs a bouncer on middle. Kane Williamson watches it sail over his head.
Full and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a brace.
Another dot ball! A full ball, on off. Kane Williamson pushes it to the left of covers where Kohli dives and stops it.
A slower full ball, on off. Kane Williamson pushes it to point.
A short ball, angling on middle, pulled away to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Kane Williamson guides it to third man for a single.

DRINKS! India will need this break more than anything. Daryl Mitchell is enjoying his time at the middle and is close to getting his maiden T20I fifty as well. Along with Kane Williamson, he will look to finish and wrap this game quickly as only 28 runs are required from 10 overs. Jasprit Bumrah comes back on.
A yorker, around off. Daryl Mitchell digs it out watchfully. 28 runs needed from 60 balls now!
FOUR! SMASHED! Full ball, outside off. Daryl Mitchell hangs back and smashes it past the bowler for another boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! Back of a length, on middle and leg. Mitchell stays back and hoicks it in the vacant deep mid-wicket region to collect a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, outside off. Daryl Mitchell looks to heave it away but he misses.
SIX! BANG! Daryl Mitchell is enjoying his time out in the middle and he looks in a hurry to finish this game! Good-length ball, around off. Mitchell heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Thakur starts with a short-of-a-length ball, outside off. Daryl Mitchell hits it towards mid off.
Shardul Thakur is brought into the attack.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Daryl Mitchell eases it to long on and keeps the strike for the next over.
Nicely tossed up, around off, turning in sharply. Kane Williamson prods to defend but he gets a thick inside edge to wide of deep mid-wicket. The batters cross for one.
On a length, around middle. Daryl Mitchell hangs back and drills it to long on for a run.

A bit quicker, around off. Kane Williamson stays back and guides it behind square on the off side for a single. Was a risky single as Ravindra Jadeja was quick to collect the ball and fire a throw at the striker's end. Daryl Mitchell was fortunate that the ball didn't hit the stumps otherwise he was a goner.
Flatter ball, around off. Daryl Mitchell skips down and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, around off. Daryl Mitchell looks to play the sweep but he misses and gets hit on the pad.
Varun Chakravarthy to end his spell here.
Full ball, on middle. Kane Williamson knocks it to point. 47 needed in 72 balls.
Full and on off. Kane Williamson comes down the track and lofts it over covers and wide of sweeper cover for a brace.
Darted on the pads, pushed to mid-wicket for one more.
Angles a full ball, on middle, punched to covers for a single.
FOUR! Played with such soft hands! A flatter ball, outside off. Kane Williamson waits for it and opens the face of the bat in the end. Steers it past short third man for a boundary.
Full and on middle, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle. Daryl Mitchell miscues his pull to the leg side and collects a single. 56 needed in 78 balls.
SIX! THUMPED! A length ball, on off. Daryl Mitchell uses the depth of his crease and powers it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Did not come off the middle but cleared the fence with ease.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
A length ball, outside off. Kane Williamson steps down and pushes it through covers for a single. Making gaps for himself pretty nicely.
WIDE! A short ball, angling down the leg side. Kane Williamson sits under it.
Full and on off. Daryl Mitchell mistimes his heave to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Kane Williamson runs it down to third man for a single.
Mohammed Shami comes into the attack.
Short and outside off, slapped to covers. At the end of the Powerplay, New Zealand are 44/1. 67 needed in 84 balls.
FOUR! Good shot! A flatter ball, outside off. Daryl Mitchell slaps it through covers for a boundary. Turning out to be an expensive over.
FOUR! Just wide and over mid on! A short ball, around off. Daryl Mitchell whacks it wide of mid on and the ball runs away to the mid-wicket fence.
Tossed up on middle. Daryl Mitchell blocks it back to the bowler.
SIX! High and Handsome! A flatter ball, around off. Daryl Mitchell stays back and heaves it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
A flighted ball, on middle. Daryl Mitchell skips down and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Ravindra Jadeja comes to bowl now.
Dot to end the over! Good one from Varun Chakravarthy! A flatter ball, on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
A loopy ball, on off. Kane Williamson watchfully defends it.
Full and on middle. Daryl Mitchell lifts it to long on for a single.
Here comes the reverse sweep by Daryl Mitchell but he finds short third man.
A flatter ball, outside off. Kane Williamson chops it softly to short third man for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked to short mid-wicket. Kane Williamson wants a single but is sent back.
Length ball, outside off. Kane Williamson dabs it to third man for a run.

Bumrah tries to bowl another yorker, but bowls a low full toss, outside off. Daryl Mitchell drives it through extra cover. Hardik Pandya chases it and stops the ball right inside the boundary. Saves a run for his team.
Kane Williamson walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Jasprit Bumrah draws first blood. Slower delivery, on a length, outside off. Martin Guptill is beaten by the lack of the pace and into his stroke too early. He wanted to loft but completely miscued it towards mid on. Shardul Thakur there takes the ball on the second attempt. Martin Guptill walks back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Shardul Thakur b Jasprit Bumrah

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Just over Hardik Pandya at mid off! Length ball, on middle. Martin Guptill advances down the track and smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
A yorker on off, Guptill keeps it out.
Back of a length, on off. Guptill dabs it into the ground. The ball goes towards the keeper. He looks for a single but is sent back by Daryl Mitchell.

TWO WIDES! Short ball from Bumrah, on middle and leg. Daryl Mitchell looks to pull it away but misses. Rishabh Pant puts a big stretch to his left to stop the ball. Gets his gloves on it. The batters steal a single. The umpire signals wide for height.
Tosses it up, on middle. Martin Guptill gets on his knee and slog-sweeps it to deep backward square leg. Ravindra Jadeja runs to his right to stop the ball. Keeps it down to a couple.
On off, heaved towards deep backward square leg for a run.
Floats it up, on middle and leg. Guptill heaves it to long on for a single now.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Tosses it up, on off. Martin Guptill stands tall and lifts it towards long off for another boundary. This is Guptill at it's best.
FOUR! Slightly short, outside off. Martin Guptill sees the width and cuts it past backward point for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on middle. Guptill nudges it to mid-wicket off the back foot.
Jasprit Bumrah attacking the stumps up top! Full again, on middle. Daryl Mitchell defends it to the off side. A good over from him. Just a single from it.
A low dipping full toss, on leg, nipping in late. Daryl Mitchell looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
On a length, on middle. Guptill nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fires a yorker, on middle, at 139 kph. Martin Guptill defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, on middle. Guptill jams it out to mid on.
Length ball, on off. Guptill comes forward and pushes it to mid on.
Who will bowl from the other end? Jasprit Bumrah it is!
Outside off, pushed to point. A bit of a hesitation between the two for a single but no harm done in the end.
Tosses it up, on off. Guptill pushes it to long on for a run.

Varun Chakravarthy sees Daryl Mitchell advancing down the track so bowls it down the leg side. Mitchell does well to get his body as otherwise Rishabh Pant would have had a stumping chance. He works it off his pads on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Slower through the air, on middle. Guptill pushes it to long on for a single.
Sliding on middle and leg, Guptill defends it to mid on.
New Zealand and Martin Guptill are underway! Full and on middle, Guptill puts a stride forward and nudges if off the inner half of the bat through square leg for a brace.
